selection: All 26 original annual coefficient workbooks and both original seasonal load-share workbooks, compressed without changing source bytes.
comparison: Every coefficient, input load/loss factor, period, source group label, year/as-of label and missing value across all 26 original XLS/XLSX workbooks was compared independently with xlrd/openpyxl. Every operator share, effective date, heading and note in both load-shed originals was also compared.
units: NOIE SSC * published on/off-peak load + SIC matches SONLF/SOFFLF * 100 in every populated source case. Final coefficients return percent; source loss-factor input cells retain their fractional values. ERCOT input and final correction bases remain separately labeled.
limitations: 2001-2010 workbooks omit effective-date tables; no dates are inferred from season or year.
2020 and 2026 winter ranges are reversed in the sources. Raw labels are retained; effectiveFrom/effectiveThrough are None.
LPL spring 2021 has six blank numeric cells; its area/season row is retained with None values.
The 2002 COCS coefficient columns are offset from the input columns; tables are joined by published area labels. PUB and BPUB, Rayburn, TEXLA and other original area names remain distinct.
Internal base-case and For Testing Only calculation tables remain in the downloadable originals; the reader exposes published final coefficients and their input basis.
Operator shares are published load percentages, not shed MW or outage probabilities. Tables remain effective until replaced; no end date is inferred.
As-of labels are not proof of public availability; originals and revisions are not deduplicated by year or season.
